title: द्वितीयोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks for another story of the great, and Bhishma tells how the householder Sudarshana, with his wife Oghavati, vowed to conquer death by hospitality. When Death, following him, comes in the guise of a guest brahmin, Sudarshana's wife honours the guest and he is defeated by their truth and hospitality.
summary.kn: ಮಹಾತ್ಮರ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಕಥೆ ಕೇಳಲು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಗೃಹಸ್ಥ ಸುದರ್ಶನ ಪತ್ನಿ ಓಘವತಿಯೊಡನೆ ಅತಿಥಿ ಸತ್ಕಾರದಿಂದ ಮೃತ್ಯುವನ್ನು ಗೆಲ್ಲಲು ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅತಿಥಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣನ ವೇಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದ ಮೃತ್ಯು ಅವರ ಸತ್ಯ-ಸತ್ಕಾರದಿಂದ ಸೋಲುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर किसी और महापुरुष की कथा सुनना चाहते हैं, और भीष्म बताते हैं कि गृहस्थ सुदर्शन ने पत्नी ओघवती के साथ अतिथि-सत्कार से मृत्यु को जीतने का व्रत लिया। अतिथि ब्राह्मण के वेश में आया मृत्यु उनके सत्य और आतिथ्य से हार जाता है।
summary.te: మహాత్ముల మరో కథను వినాలని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు కోరతాడు; గృహస్థుడు సుదర్శనుడు భార్య ఓఘవతితో అతిథి సత్కారంతో మృత్యువును జయించాలని వ్రతం పట్టిన కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. అతిథి బ్రాహ్మణ వేషంలో వచ్చిన మృత్యువు వారి సత్యం, సత్కారంతో ఓడిపోతాడు.
summary.ta: பெரியோரின் மற்றொரு கதையைக் கேட்க யுதிஷ்டிரர் விரும்ப, இல்லறத்தான் சுதர்சனன் மனைவி ஓகவதியுடன் விருந்தோம்பலால் மரணத்தை வெல்ல உறுதி பூண்ட கதையைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். விருந்தினர் அந்தணன் வடிவில் வந்த மரணம் அவர்களின் உண்மையாலும் உபசாரத்தாலும் தோற்கிறது.
summary.ml: മറ്റൊരു മഹത്തായ കഥ പറയാൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; ഗൃഹസ്ഥനായ സുദർശനൻ ഭാര്യ ഓഘവതിയോടൊപ്പം ആതിഥ്യത്തിലൂടെ മൃത്യുവിനെ ജയിക്കുമെന്ന് പ്രതിജ്ഞയെടുത്തതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പിന്തുടർന്ന് മൃത്യു അതിഥിയായ ബ്രാഹ്മണന്റെ രൂപത്തിൽ വരുമ്പോൾ, സുദർശനന്റെ ഭാര്യ അതിഥിയെ ആദരിക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ സത്യവും ആതിഥ്യവും കൊണ്ട് മൃത്യു പരാജയപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.2; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
पितामह महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद ।
श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानमिदं मतिमतां वर ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, greatly wise master of all the scriptures, best of the discerning, I have heard this great tale.

verses.text:
भूयस्तु श्रोतुमिच्छामि धर्मार्थसहितं नृप ।
कथ्यमानं त्वया किंचित्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: I wish to hear more, king, something joined with dharma and purpose; please explain to me what you tell.

verses.text:
केन मृत्युर्गृहस्थेन धर्ममाश्रित्य निर्जितः ।
इत्येतत्सर्वमाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन मम पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: Tell me fully and truly: what householder, relying on dharma, conquered Death?

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
यथा मृत्युर्गृहस्थेन धर्ममाश्रित्य निर्जितः ॥

meaning.en: On this too they cite an ancient tale, of how a householder conquered Death by relying on dharma.

verses.text:
मनोः प्रजापते राजन्निक्ष्वाकुरभवत्सुतः ।
तस्य पुत्रशतं जज्ञे नृपतेः सूर्यवर्चसः ॥

meaning.en: O king, Ikshvaku was a son of Manu, the lord of creatures; that sun-bright king had a hundred sons.

verses.text:
दशमस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु दशाश्वो नाम भारत ।
माहिष्मत्यामभूद्राजा धर्मात्मा सत्यविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: His tenth son, Bharata, was named Dashashva; he was king in Mahishmati, righteous and truly valiant.

verses.text:
दशाश्वस्य सुतस्त्वासीद्राजा परमधार्मिकः ।
सत्ये तपसि दाने च यस्य नित्यं रतं मनः ॥

meaning.en: Dashashva's son was a supremely righteous king whose mind was ever set on truth, austerity and giving.

verses.text:
मदिराश्व इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिः ।
धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च निरतो योऽभवत्सदा ॥

meaning.en: He was known on earth as Madirashva, a lord of the earth, always devoted to archery and the Veda.

verses.text:
मदिराश्वस्य पुत्रस्तु द्युतिमान्नाम पार्थिवः ।
महाभागो महातेजा महासत्त्वो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Madirashva's son was the king named Dyutiman, fortunate, radiant, powerful and mighty.

verses.text:
पुत्रो द्युतिमतस्त्वासीत्सुवीरो नाम पार्थिवः ।
धर्मात्मा कोशवांश्चापि देवराज इवापरः ॥

meaning.en: Dyutiman's son was the king Suvira, righteous and wealthy, like a second king of the gods.

verses.text:
सुवीरस्य तु पुत्रोऽभूत्सर्वसंग्रामदुर्जयः ।
दुर्जयेत्यभिविख्यातः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ॥

meaning.en: Suvira's son was invincible in every battle, known as Durjaya, skilled in all the scriptures.

verses.text:
दुर्जयस्येन्द्रवपुषः पुत्रोऽग्निसदृशद्युतिः ।
दुर्योधनो नाम महान्राजासीद्राजसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Durjaya, who had the bearing of Indra, had a son of fiery splendor, the great king Duryodhana, best of kings.

verses.text:
तस्येन्द्रसमवीर्यस्य संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनः ।
विषयश्च प्रभावश्च तुल्यमेवाभ्यवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: He had Indra's valor and never retreated in battle; his realm and his power grew equally.

verses.text:
रत्नैर्धनैश्च पशुभिः सस्यैश्चापि पृथग्विधैः ।
नगरं विषयश्चास्य प्रतिपूर्णं तदाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: His city and realm were then full of jewels, wealth, cattle and many kinds of grain.

verses.text:
न तस्य विषये चाभूत्कृपणो नापि दुर्गतः ।
व्याधितो वा कृशो वापि तस्मिन्नाभून्नरः क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: In his realm there was no miser, no wretched person, and nowhere a sick or emaciated man.

verses.text:
सुदक्षिणो मधुरवागनसूयुर्जितेन्द्रियः ।
धर्मात्मा चानृशंसश्च विक्रान्तोऽथाविकत्थनः ॥

meaning.en: He was kind, sweet-spoken, free of envy, master of his senses, righteous, merciful, brave and not boastful.

verses.text:
यज्वा वदान्यो मेधावी ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यसंगरः ।
न चावमन्ता दाता च वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ॥

meaning.en: He was a sacrificer, generous, intelligent, devoted to brahmins, true to his word, never contemptuous, a giver, and a master of the Vedas and their limbs.

verses.text:
तं नर्मदा देवनदी पुण्या शीतजला शिवा ।
चकमे पुरुषश्रेष्ठं स्वेन भावेन भारत ॥

meaning.en: Narmada, the holy, cool-watered, auspicious divine river, loved that best of men of her own accord, Bharata.

verses.text:
तस्य जज्ञे तदा नद्यां कन्या राजीवलोचना ।
नाम्ना सुदर्शना राजन्रूपेण च सुदर्शना ॥

meaning.en: Then a lotus-eyed daughter was born to him from the river, named Sudarshana, and lovely to behold as her name says, O king.

verses.text:
तादृग्रूपा न नारीषु भूतपूर्वा युधिष्ठिर ।
दुर्योधनसुता यादृगभवद्वरवर्णिनी ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, no woman before had such beauty as that fair daughter of Duryodhana had.

verses.text:
तामग्निश्चकमे साक्षाद्राजकन्यां सुदर्शनाम् ।
भूत्वा च ब्राह्मणः साक्षाद्वरयामास तं नृपम् ॥

meaning.en: Agni himself desired the princess Sudarshana, and taking the form of a brahmin he asked the king for her hand.

verses.text:
दरिद्रश्चासवर्णश्च ममायमिति पार्थिवः ।
न दित्सति सुतां तस्मै तां विप्राय सुदर्शनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Thinking, "He is poor and not of our rank," the king did not wish to give his daughter Sudarshana to that brahmin.

verses.text:
ततोऽस्य वितते यज्ञे नष्टोऽभूद्धव्यवाहनः ।
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा वाक्यमाहर्त्विजस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then, at the king's sacrifice, the fire disappeared. The king said to the priests:

verses.text:
दुष्कृतं मम किं नु स्याद्भवतां वा द्विजर्षभाः ।
येन नाशं जगामाग्निः कृतं कुपुरुषेष्विव ॥

meaning.en: "What wrong have I done, or you, best of brahmins, that the fire has vanished as if among wicked men?

verses.text:
न ह्यल्पं दुष्कृतं नोऽस्ति येनाग्निर्नाशमागतः ।
भवतां वाथ वा मह्यं तत्त्वेनैतद्विमृश्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: The wrong we have done cannot be small, for the fire to vanish, whether yours or mine; examine this truly."

verses.text:
एतद्राज्ञो वचः श्रुत्वा विप्रास्ते भरतर्षभ ।
नियता वाग्यताश्चैव पावकं शरणं ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the king's words, best of Bharatas, the brahmins, disciplined and silent, took refuge in Fire.

verses.text:
तान्दर्शयामास तदा भगवान्हव्यवाहनः ।
स्वं रूपं दीप्तिमत्कृत्वा शरदर्कसमद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Fire, carrier of oblations, showed himself to them in his radiant form, bright as the autumn sun.

verses.text:
ततो महात्मा तानाह दहनो ब्राह्मणर्षभान् ।
वरयाम्यात्मनोऽर्थाय दुर्योधनसुतामिति ॥

meaning.en: That great-souled one then said to the brahmin chiefs, "I ask for Duryodhana's daughter for myself."

verses.text:
ततस्ते काल्यमुत्थाय तस्मै राज्ञे न्यवेदयन् ।
ब्राह्मणा विस्मिताः सर्वे यदुक्तं चित्रभानुना ॥

meaning.en: Rising at dawn, the astonished brahmins reported to the king what Agni of the bright banner had said.

verses.text:
ततः स राजा तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ।
अवाप्य परमं हर्षं तथेति प्राह बुद्धिमान् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of those who speak of Brahman, the wise king was overjoyed and said, "So be it."

verses.text:
प्रायाचत नृपः शुल्कं भगवन्तं विभावसुम् ।
नित्यं सांनिध्यमिह ते चित्रभानो भवेदिति ।
तमाह भगवानग्निरेवमस्त्विति पार्थिवम् ॥

meaning.en: The king asked the blessed Fire, as bride-price, "May your presence be here always, Agni." The blessed Agni told the king, "So be it."

verses.text:
ततः सांनिध्यमध्यापि माहिष्मत्यां विभावसोः ।
दृष्टं हि सहदेवेन दिशो विजयता तदा ॥

meaning.en: Hence Fire's presence is seen to this day in Mahishmati; Sahadeva saw it while conquering the quarters.

verses.text:
ततस्तां समलंकृत्य कन्यामहतवाससम् ।
ददौ दुर्योधनो राजा पावकाय महात्मने ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana adorned the girl in fresh garments and gave her to the great-souled Fire.

verses.text:
प्रतिजग्राह चाग्निस्तां राजपुत्रीं सुदर्शनाम् ।
विधिना वेददृष्टेन वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे ॥

meaning.en: Agni accepted the princess Sudarshana by the rite seen in the Veda, as at a sacrifice one takes the stream of ghee.

verses.text:
तस्या रूपेण शीलेन कुलेन वपुषा श्रिया ।
अभवत्प्रीतिमानग्निर्गर्भं तस्यां समादधे ॥

meaning.en: Pleased by her beauty, character, family, form and splendor, Agni placed a child in her.

verses.text:
तस्यां समभवत्पुत्रो नाम्नाग्नेयः सुदर्शनः ।
शिशुरेवाध्यगात्सर्वं स च ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥

meaning.en: She bore a son named Sudarshana, son of Agni; even as a child he learned everything, including eternal Brahman.

verses.text:
अथौघवान्नाम नृपो नृगस्यासीत्पितामहः ।
तस्याप्योघवती कन्या पुत्रश्चौघरथोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: There was a king named Oghavan, grandfather of Nriga; he had a daughter, Oghavati, and a son, Ogharatha.

verses.text:
तामोघवान्ददौ तस्मै स्वयमोघवतीं सुताम् ।
सुदर्शनाय विदुषे भार्यार्थे देवरूपिणीम् ॥

meaning.en: Oghavan himself gave his daughter Oghavati, divine in form, to the learned Sudarshana as his wife.

verses.text:
स गृहस्थाश्रमरतस्तया सह सुदर्शनः ।
कुरुक्षेत्रेऽवसद्राजन्नोघवत्या समन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Devoted to the householder's life, Sudarshana lived with Oghavati at Kurukshetra, O king.

verses.text:
गृहस्थश्चावजेष्यामि मृत्युमित्येव स प्रभो ।
प्रतिज्ञामकरोद्धीमान्दीप्ततेजा विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: The wise and radiant one vowed, "As a householder I will conquer Death."

verses.text:
तामथौघवतीं राजन्स पावकसुतोऽब्रवीत् ।
अतिथेः प्रतिकूलं ते न कर्तव्यं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Then Agni's son said to Oghavati: "You must never do anything against a guest.

verses.text:
येन येन च तुष्येत नित्यमेव त्वयातिथिः ।
अप्यात्मनः प्रदानेन न ते कार्या विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: Whatever pleases a guest, you must always provide, even if it means giving yourself; do not hesitate over it.

verses.text:
एतद्व्रतं मम सदा हृदि संपरिवर्तते ।
गृहस्थानां हि सुश्रोणि नातिथेर्विद्यते परम् ॥

meaning.en: This vow ever turns in my heart: for householders, fair-hipped one, there is nothing higher than the guest.

verses.text:
प्रमाणं यदि वामोरु वचस्ते मम शोभने ।
इदं वचनमव्यग्रा हृदि त्वं धारयेः सदा ॥

meaning.en: If my word is your authority, fair one, keep this saying always in your heart without wavering.

verses.text:
निष्क्रान्ते मयि कल्याणि तथा संनिहितेऽनघे ।
नातिथिस्तेऽवमन्तव्यः प्रमाणं यद्यहं तव ॥

meaning.en: Auspicious, blameless one, whether I have gone out or am near, you must never slight a guest, if I am your authority."

verses.text:
तमब्रवीदोघवती यता मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः ।
न मे त्वद्वचनात्किंचिदकर्तव्यं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Oghavati, bowing her head with joined palms, replied, "Nothing you say will I ever fail to do."

verses.text:
जिगीषमाणं तु गृहे तदा मृत्युः सुदर्शनम् ।
पृष्ठतोऽन्वगमद्राजन्रन्ध्रान्वेषी तदा सदा ॥

meaning.en: While Sudarshana, eager to win, lived at home, Death followed close behind him, always seeking a gap.

verses.text:
इध्मार्थं तु गते तस्मिन्नग्निपुत्रे सुदर्शने ।
अतिथिर्ब्राह्मणः श्रीमांस्तामाहौघवतीं तदा ॥

meaning.en: When Agni's son Sudarshana had gone for firewood, a radiant brahmin guest said to Oghavati:

verses.text:
आतिथ्यं दत्तमिच्छामि त्वयाद्य वरवर्णिनि ।
प्रमाणं यदि धर्मस्ते गृहस्थाश्रमसंमतः ॥

meaning.en: "Fair lady, I want hospitality from you today, if you accept the dharma approved for householders."

verses.text:
इत्युक्ता तेन विप्रेण राजपुत्री यशस्विनी ।
विधिना प्रतिजग्राह वेदोक्तेन विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Addressed so by that brahmin, the renowned princess welcomed him by the rite taught in the Veda.

verses.text:
आसनं चैव पाद्यं च तस्मै दत्त्वा द्विजातये ।
प्रोवाचौघवती विप्रं केनार्थः किं ददामि ते ॥

meaning.en: Having offered the twice-born a seat and water for his feet, Oghavati said to him, "What do you need? What shall I give you?"

verses.text:
तामब्रवीत्ततो विप्रो राजपुत्रीं सुदर्शनाम् ।
त्वया ममार्थः कल्याणि निर्विशङ्के तदाचर ॥

meaning.en: The brahmin said to the princess Sudarshana, "It is you I need, gentle lady. Do it without hesitation.

verses.text:
यदि प्रमाणं धर्मस्ते गृहस्थाश्रमसंमतः ।
प्रदानेनात्मनो राज्ञि कर्तुमर्हसि मे प्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: If you accept the householder's dharma, queen, you should please me by giving yourself."

verses.text:
तथा संछन्द्यमानोऽन्यैरीप्सितैर्नृपकन्यया ।
नान्यमात्मप्रदानात्स तस्या वव्रे वरं द्विजः ॥

meaning.en: Though the princess tempted him with other things he might desire, the brahmin chose no boon other than the gift of herself.

verses.text:
सा तु राजसुता स्मृत्वा भर्तुर्वचनमादितः ।
तथेति लज्जमाना सा तमुवाच द्विजर्षभम् ॥

meaning.en: Remembering her husband's words from the start, the princess said shyly to the best of brahmins, "So be it."

verses.text:
ततो रहः स विप्रर्षिः सा चैवोपविवेश ह ।
संस्मृत्य भर्तुर्वचनं गृहस्थाश्रमकाङ्क्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: Then that brahmin sage and she went into privacy, she remembering the words of her husband, who longed for the householder's life.

verses.text:
अथेध्मान्समुपादाय स पावकिरुपागमत् ।
मृत्युना रौद्रभावेन नित्यं बन्धुरिवान्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Meanwhile Agni's son took the firewood and returned, with grim Death in tow like a constant companion.

verses.text:
ततस्त्वाश्रममागम्य स पावकसुतस्तदा ।
तामाजुहावौघवतीं क्वासि यातेति चासकृत् ॥

meaning.en: Arriving at the hermitage, Agni's son called Oghavati again and again: "Where have you gone?"

verses.text:
तस्मै प्रतिवचः सा तु भर्त्रे न प्रददौ तदा ।
कराभ्यां तेन विप्रेण स्पृष्टा भर्तृव्रता सती ॥

meaning.en: She, devoted to her husband, did not answer him then, since the brahmin had touched her with his hands.

verses.text:
उच्छिष्टास्मीति मन्वाना लज्जिता भर्तुरेव च ।
तूष्णींभूताभवत्साध्वी न चोवाचाथ किंचन ॥

meaning.en: Thinking herself defiled and ashamed before her husband, the virtuous woman stayed silent and said nothing.

verses.text:
अथ तां पुनरेवेदं प्रोवाच स सुदर्शनः ।
क्व सा साध्वी क्व सा याता गरीयः किमतो मम ॥

meaning.en: Sudarshana called again: "Where is that virtuous woman, where has she gone? What matters more to me than this?

verses.text:
पतिव्रता सत्यशीला नित्यं चैवार्जवे रता ।
कथं न प्रत्युदेत्यद्य स्मयमाना यथा पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Faithful, truthful, ever fond of honesty, why does she not come to meet me today, smiling as before?"

verses.text:
उटजस्थस्तु तं विप्रः प्रत्युवाच सुदर्शनम् ।
अतिथिं विद्धि संप्राप्तं पावके ब्राह्मणं च माम् ॥

meaning.en: From inside the hut the brahmin replied to Sudarshana: "Know that a brahmin guest has arrived, son of Fire.

verses.text:
अनया छन्द्यमानोऽहं भार्यया तव सत्तम ।
तैस्तैरतिथिसत्कारैरार्जवेऽस्या दृढं मनः ॥

meaning.en: Your wife has been tempting me, best of men, with all manner of hospitality, and her mind is firmly honest.

verses.text:
अनेन विधिना सेयं मामर्चति शुभानना ।
अनुरूपं यदत्राद्य तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: In this manner the fair-faced woman honors me; you should say what is fitting now."

verses.text:
कूटमुद्गरहस्तस्तु मृत्युस्तं वै समन्वयात् ।
हीनप्रतिज्ञमत्रैनं वधिष्यामीति चिन्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: Death, with a mallet in hand, followed Sudarshana, thinking, "I will kill him here once he breaks his vow."

verses.text:
सुदर्शनस्तु मनसा कर्मणा चक्षुषा गिरा ।
त्यक्तेर्ष्यस्त्यक्तमन्युश्च स्मयमानोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Sudarshana, free of jealousy and anger in mind, deed, sight and speech, smiled and said:

verses.text:
सुरतं तेऽस्तु विप्राग्र्य प्रीतिर्हि परमा मम ।
गृहस्थस्य हि धर्मोऽग्र्यः संप्राप्तातिथिपूजनम् ॥

meaning.en: "May your pleasure be complete, best of brahmins; I am greatly pleased. The householder's highest dharma is to honor an arrived guest.

verses.text:
अतिथिः पूजितो यस्य गृहस्थस्य तु गच्छति ।
नान्यस्तस्मात्परो धर्म इति प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: The wise say there is no higher dharma than for a householder whose guest departs honored.

verses.text:
प्राणा हि मम दाराश्च यच्चान्यद्विद्यते वसु ।
अतिथिभ्यो मया देयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम् ॥

meaning.en: My life, my wives and whatever other wealth I have must be given to guests; that is the vow I have undertaken.

verses.text:
निःसंदिग्धं मया वाक्यमेतत्ते समुदाहृतम् ।
तेनाहं विप्र सत्येन स्वयमात्मानमालभे ॥

meaning.en: I have said this without any doubt; by that truth, brahmin, I take my own self as witness.

verses.text:
पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् ।
बुद्धिरात्मा मनः कालो दिशश्चैव गुणा दश ॥

meaning.en: Earth, wind, space, water and fire the fifth, intellect, self, mind, time and the directions: these ten qualities,

verses.text:
नित्यमेते हि पश्यन्ति देहिनां देहसंश्रिताः ।
सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चापि कर्म धर्मभृतां वर ॥

meaning.en: dwelling in the bodies of embodied beings, always see their good and bad deeds, best of the upholders of dharma.

verses.text:
यथैषा नानृता वाणी मयाद्य समुदाहृता ।
तेन सत्येन मां देवाः पालयन्तु दहन्तु वा ॥

meaning.en: As I have spoken no untruth today, by that truth let the gods protect me or burn me."

verses.text:
ततो नादः समभवद्दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत ।
असकृत्सत्यमित्येव नैतन्मिथ्येति सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Then a sound arose in all directions, O Bharata, again and again: "True! This is not false," from everywhere.

verses.text:
उटजात्तु ततस्तस्मान्निश्चक्राम स वै द्विजः ।
वपुषा खं च भूमिं च व्याप्य वायुरिवोद्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then that twice-born came out of the hut, filling sky and earth with his form, rising like the wind.

verses.text:
स्वरेण विप्रः शैक्षेण त्रीँल्लोकाननुनादयन् ।
उवाच चैनं धर्मज्ञं पूर्वमामन्त्र्य नामतः ॥

meaning.en: Making the three worlds resound with his Vedic voice, he first called the knower of dharma by name and said:

verses.text:
धर्मोऽहमस्मि भद्रं ते जिज्ञासार्थं तवानघ ।
प्राप्तः सत्यं च ते ज्ञात्वा प्रीतिर्मे परमा त्वयि ॥

meaning.en: "I am Dharma. Blessings to you, blameless one; I came to test you, and knowing your truth I am deeply pleased with you.

verses.text:
विजितश्च त्वया मृत्युर्योऽयं त्वामनुगच्छति ।
रन्ध्रान्वेषी तव सदा त्वया धृत्या वशीकृतः ॥

meaning.en: You have conquered Death, who follows you, ever watching for a gap; he has been mastered by your steadiness.

verses.text:
न चास्ति शक्तिस्त्रैलोक्ये कस्यचित्पुरुषोत्तम ।
पतिव्रतामिमां साध्वीं तवोद्वीक्षितुमप्युत ॥

meaning.en: In the three worlds no one, best of men, has the power even to look at this faithful, virtuous wife of yours.

verses.text:
रक्षिता त्वद्गुणैरेषा पतिव्रतगुणैस्तथा ।
अधृष्या यदियं ब्रूयात्तथा तन्नान्यथा भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: She is protected by your virtues and by a devoted wife's virtues, and cannot be assailed; what she says will come true and not otherwise.

verses.text:
एषा हि तपसा स्वेन संयुक्ता ब्रह्मवादिनी ।
पावनार्थं च लोकस्य सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Endowed with her own austerity and a speaker of Brahman, she will become the best of rivers for the purification of the world.

verses.text:
अर्धेनौघवती नाम त्वामर्धेनानुयास्यति ।
शरीरेण महाभागा योगो ह्यस्या वशे स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: With half of herself she will be named Oghavati, and with half she will follow you in her body; this great lady has yoga in her power.

verses.text:
अनया सह लोकांश्च गन्तासि तपसार्जितान् ।
यत्र नावृत्तिमभ्येति शाश्वतांस्तान्सनातनान् ॥

meaning.en: With her you will reach worlds won by austerity, eternal, from which there is no return.

verses.text:
अनेन चैव देहेन लोकांस्त्वमभिपत्स्यसे ।
निर्जितश्च त्वया मृत्युरैश्वर्यं च तवोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: In this very body you will gain those worlds; you have conquered Death, and your sovereignty is supreme.

verses.text:
पञ्च भूतान्यतिक्रान्तः स्ववीर्याच्च मनोभवः ।
गृहस्थधर्मेणानेन कामक्रोधौ च ते जितौ ॥

meaning.en: By your own strength you have passed beyond the five elements and the mind-born; by this householder's dharma you have conquered desire and anger.

verses.text:
स्नेहो रागश्च तन्द्री च मोहो द्रोहश्च केवलः ।
तव शुश्रूषया राजन्राजपुत्र्या विनिर्जिताः ॥

meaning.en: Affection, passion, sloth, delusion and malice, all of them, O king, have been conquered by you through your service to the princess."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
शुक्लानां तु सहस्रेण वाजिनां रथमुत्तमम् ।
युक्तं प्रगृह्य भगवान्व्यवसायो जगाम तम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Resolve, taking a fine chariot yoked with a thousand white horses, went to him.

verses.text:
मृत्युरात्मा च लोकाश्च जिता भूतानि पञ्च च ।
बुद्धिः कालो मनो व्योम कामक्रोधौ तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Death, the self and the worlds were conquered, and the five elements, intellect, time, mind, space, desire and anger.

verses.text:
तस्माद्गृहाश्रमस्थस्य नान्यद्दैवतमस्ति वै ।
ऋतेऽतिथिं नरव्याघ्र मनसैतद्विचारय ॥

meaning.en: Therefore for one living as a householder there is no other deity than the guest, tiger among men; ponder this in your mind.

verses.text:
अतिथिः पूजितो यस्य ध्यायते मनसा शुभम् ।
न तत्क्रतुशतेनापि तुल्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: The wise say that even a hundred sacrifices do not equal the good a householder wishes in his mind when a guest is honored.

verses.text:
पात्रं त्वतिथिमासाद्य शीलाढ्यं यो न पूजयेत् ।
स दत्त्वा सुकृतं तस्य क्षपयेत ह्यनर्चितः ॥

meaning.en: One who does not honor a worthy guest rich in virtue, even after giving, destroys his own merit, being unhonored.

verses.text:
एतत्ते कथितं पुत्र मयाख्यानमनुत्तमम् ।
यथा हि विजितो मृत्युर्गृहस्थेन पुराभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Son, I have told you this unsurpassed tale of how a householder once conquered Death.

verses.text:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यमिदमाख्यानमुत्तमम् ।
बुभूषताभिमन्तव्यं सर्वदुश्चरितापहम् ॥

meaning.en: This excellent tale brings wealth, fame and long life; one who wishes to prosper should honor it, for it removes all misdeeds.

verses.text:
य इदं कथयेद्विद्वानहन्यहनि भारत ।
सुदर्शनस्य चरितं पुण्याँल्लोकानवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: A learned man who recounts the deeds of Sudarshana day after day, O Bharata, will win holy worlds.
